results.title: Data curation walkthrough 1/2: VADCompose release to Cleaned V2 (human review)
results.summary: Onboarding walkthrough of the first filtering stage: 1993 long recordings are segmented by frame annotations, 85 raw action labels are merged into 9 parent classes, and each candidate segment is human-reviewed (pass/fail/edit/trim) for action purity, boundaries, and label semantics, keeping 1446 segments. Per action: 5 deleted examples (explicit fails vs never-admitted, labeled) side by side with 2 kept examples, rendered from the raw 20 fps release motion.

results.title: Data curation walkthrough 2/2: Cleaned V2 to Tracked V3 rev4 (physical execution + gate)
results.summary: Onboarding walkthrough of the second filtering stage: reference motions are executed by per-action physical trackers (SONIC for walk/kick, D6 GTrXL for six upper-body actions) and gated by four automatic criteria (jerk ratio, acceleration ratio, two-sided motion preservation, phase lag), keeping 1063 of 1392 executed clips. Per action: 5 gate-rejected executions with their actual gate readings and rejection reasons, side by side with 2 accepted ones (white robot = execution, blue ghost = reference). Ends with the gate's three known blind spots.

results.title: BABEL→G1 8-class kinematic reference pool: build pipeline and full human audit (pass/fail examples)
results.summary: What was done, no interpretation: 13,258 raw AMASS SMPL-X sequences retargeted to Unitree G1 at native 50 Hz (GMR, frame-rate patched), joined with BABEL frame-level labels, segmented into 8 action classes, filtered by automatic gates (concurrent-label policy, IK limit-jam, clap contact loss, window dedup), then reviewed segment-by-segment by a human (7 classes in full plus the first 250 walk segments). 909 segments / 35 minutes kept out of 1759. One PASS vs FAIL playback pair per class, with the reviewer's original rejection notes.

results.title: Preliminary: tracker performance review on fast upper-limb oscillations (measurements as-is)
results.summary: Full measurement display, no interpretation: the 20 fastest sustained wrist-oscillation windows from the reviewed VADCompose V2 reference segments (walk/kick excluded, 1.67-2.22 Hz, located by a sliding-window scan of the full release) executed by five trackers. Per clip: five-panel video with reference ghost, amplitude-family / end-effector / arm-joint-angle time curves, per-arm wrist-amplitude retention, link error, and dominant-frequency readouts. Verdicts are recorded separately in the research repo.

results.title: Rollouts V3 as delivered: gate, executor assignment, and the tracking-quality envelope
results.summary: 50Hz executed-state humanoid trajectories for planner training. Two controllers with complementary measured failure modes split the work: D6 GTrXL self-generates jitter on locomotion (jerk 6.8x/4.4x reference) while SONIC low-passes motion away and runs its arms 80-100 ms late, so kick and walk go to SONIC and the six upper-body actions to D6. Four criteria on joint kinematics keep 1063 of 1392 clips. Because none of them reads world position, this report measures that separately: world-frame limb deviation spans 45x across actions (0.029 to 1.314 m) but collapses to 0.033-0.128 m once the pelvis is aligned — the failure mode is accumulated root drift, only in locomotion, and relative limb motion holds everywhere.

results.title: VAD_Cleaned_50Hz_Rollouts_V3: three-part gate and per-action executor assignment
results.summary: V3 assigns executors per action (SONIC for walk/kick, D6 GTrXL for the six upper-body/crouch actions) and gates rollouts on jitter, two-sided motion preservation, and phase lag; 1063/1392 clips (76.4%) pass. A pre-registered timing probe finds deceleration overshoot separates human-accepted kicks at 91% (permutation p=0.015) where 40 whole-clip metrics all fail.

results.title: Preliminary: walk/kick anti-jitter relative to D6 GTrXL
results.summary: Reward-only specialist retrain vs D6-era teachers. hf_v medians drop (walk 8.04→2.41, kick 6.20→3.61) but external visual review failed both: kick foot still jitters; walk gait initiation remains weak vs SONIC.
